meaning:
κακοῦργος, -ον
(contr. from epic κακόεργος), [in LXX. Pro.21:15 (אָוֶן, פָּעַל), Est.8:13, Sir.11:33 33:26 (Sir.33:26)* ;]
a malefactor, criminal: Luk.23:32-33, 39, 2Ti.2:9.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: There were also others, two criminals, led with him to be put to death.
in which I suffer hardship to the point of chains as a criminal. But God’s word isn’t chained.
